description: Check an email address: its syntax, whether its domain has MX records, listing up to five, and whether the domain has an address record. mail_route reads them: mx or implicit_mx (no MX, an address record) takes mail, no_mail and invalid_syntax ask for a correction, unknown means try again later. The mail server is not contacted, so a good answer does not prove that the mailbox exists. No API key, no account and no sign up.

email.description: The email address to check. Nothing is sent to it.

name: validate_email
title: Check an email address
